meta.name: remotion
meta.description: Generate walkthrough videos from Stitch projects using Remotion with smooth transitions, zooming, and text overlays

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将Stitch项目转为带动画和字幕的演示视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你有Stitch项目需要快速生成高质量的走查视频
copy.tagline_en: Turn Stitch projects into walkthrough videos with animations and captions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have Stitch projects and need to generate high-quality walkthrough videos

howto.what: 安装后，当你请求制作app演示视频时，Claude会从你的Stitch项目获取屏幕截图，然后用Remotion自动合成带有过渡动画、缩放效果和文字标注的walkthrough视频。
howto.when: 当你要求基于某个Stitch项目生成walkthrough视频时触发，例如提出“给我的计算器应用做个屏幕演示视频”等指令。

say.text: 用我的计算器应用Stitch项目生成一个屏幕演示视频。
say.note: Claude会提取截图并制作视频。

say.text: 把Stitch项目'购物应用'的截图做成Remotion视频。
say.note: 自动合成带过渡和文字标注。

say.text: 创建一个带文字标注的Stitch项目walkthrough视频。
say.note: 包含缩放和淡入淡出效果。

howto.what_en: After installation, when you request a walkthrough video, Claude will retrieve screenshots from your Stitch project and use Remotion to compose a video with transition animations, zoom effects, and text overlays.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to generate a walkthrough video based on a Stitch project, e.g., "Create a screen demo video for my Calculator App".

say_en.text: Generate a walkthrough video from my Calculator App Stitch project.
say_en.note: Claude will extract screens and produce a video.

say_en.text: Use screenshots from the Stitch project 'Shopping App' to make a Remotion video.
say_en.note: Automatically composites with transitions and text.

say_en.text: Create a Stitch project walkthrough video with text annotations.
